lastCompletedStory.title: Add model->context-window mapping, backstop fraction, and over-backstop decision

nextStoryContext: US-002 added src/orchestrator/context-window.ts as a pure config/decision layer. Exports: OPUS_CONTEXT_WINDOW (1_000_000, matching Anthropic docs for claude-opus-4-6+), ORCH_CONTEXT_BACKSTOP_FRACTION (0.8), orchestratorContextWindow(configPath?) which reads readPhaseModel('orchestrator', configPath) and maps to the correct window size (1M for current generation, 200k for older variants), and isOverContextBackstop(occupancy, window, fraction) which returns true iff occupancy > window * fraction. IMPORTANT: OPUS_CONTEXT_WINDOW is 1_000_000 (not 200_000 as the PRD notes assumed; docs validation corrected this). US-003 (the watcher wiring story) should import these exports from src/orchestrator/context-window.ts to arm ORCH_RECYCLE_MARKER when the orchestrator's occupancy crosses the backstop ceiling.

officialDocsValidated.summary: PRD notes assumed OPUS_CONTEXT_WINDOW = 200_000, but Anthropic docs confirm claude-opus-4-6, 4-7, and 4-8 all have a 1M token context window. Corrected implementation to OPUS_CONTEXT_WINDOW = 1_000_000. Also updated model->window mapping: 200k for claude-opus-4-1, claude-opus-4-5, claude-sonnet-4-5, claude-haiku-4-5, claude-3-*; 1M for claude-opus-4-6+, claude-sonnet-4-6+, claude-sonnet-5, claude-fable-5, claude-mythos-5.
